name: grit-ui
description: Grit UI — a shadcn-compatible registry of 100 React components

pnpm.//: next pulls in sharp for image optimisation, and sharp needs its install script to fetch native binaries. pnpm 10+ treats an unapproved build script as a hard error rather than a warning, which fails the Docker build after the install has otherwise succeeded. Approving it here is the non-interactive equivalent of `pnpm approve-builds`.
